author: TeIq
content: Origin: #37 audit. Light-touch integration shipped at dashboard::build_report_volume only. MemoryAnomalyDetector in polaris-backend/src/pattern/ uses per-event observe_report; rewiring to consume a per-event reputation score requires reshaping the bucket-count state machine (currently u64). PgReputationProvider on ApiState is the building block — future detector swap is a constructor change. (Note: #37 audit comment referenced #79; correct issue number is #77.)
